# partiteai_mesh_version_label (Data Source)

Finds a mesh version by its mesh and its exact label.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `label` (String) The label of the mesh version.
- `mesh_id` (String) The ID of the mesh.

### Read-Only

- `mesh_version_id` (String) The ID of the mesh version.
- `ordinal` (Number) The ordinal of the mesh version.
